supersedes: v1 (AUC vs random floor was trivially 1.0)

calibration.note: theta is DEGENERATE when F0 is identically 1.0; reported, not hidden

metric_a_auc_vs_random_TRIVIAL.warning: every value is 1.0 because random waves are orthogonal to the bank by construction. NOT evidence of discrimination.

metric_b_out_of_bank_spread.reads_as: a membership PREDICATE would give all out-of-bank inputs one low score. A wide range means a graded SIMILARITY METER.

metric_c_lexical_coupling.reads_as: if r > 0.7 the statistic tracks LEXICAL OVERLAP, not meaning

control_shuffled_bank.reads_as: if the real bank carries the signal, replacing it with random vectors must COLLAPSE the separation toward chance

control_posthoc_calibration.note: shown to confirm theta does NOT move to accommodate a family; the frozen theta comes from F0 vs F5 only

verdict.claim: A pre-projection membership score separates in-bank from out-of-bank inputs, and the shuffled-bank control collapses it, so the signal is real. BUT the statistic is a graded leXICAL similarity meter, not a membership predicate: out-of-bank scores span 0.167767..0.976057 and correlate with token overlap at r=0.449. It makes HENRI able to ABSTAIN on unrelated input; it does NOT give HENRI semantic membership or understanding.
